title: English to Marathi: Emergency, Doctor & Help Phrases
description: Emergency sentences -- call ambulance, describe symptoms, ask for help, find a hospital -- from Units 02, 10 mapped English to Marathi.
intro: Three critical emergency sentences from the Bol Marathi curriculum: calling an ambulance, describing pain to a doctor, and asking for help. Each maps the English to the Marathi with the exact words you need in a crisis.
The grammar is survival-focused: the dative pattern मला ... पाहिजे (I need...) and the imperative कॉल करा (call...). No complex structures -- just the three sentences that get you help.
tip: आंबुलन्स कॉल करा, लवकर -- say it loud, say it fast. The verb कॉल करा attaches to any emergency service: पोलिस कॉल करा, फायर कॉल करा.

sections.heading: The three survival sentences
paragraphs: 1) मला मदत पाहिजे -- I need help (the universal need frame). 2) डॉक्टर, माझं पोट दुखते -- Doctor, my stomach hurts (body part + दुखते). 3) आंबुलन्स कॉल करा, लवकर -- Call ambulance, quickly (imperative + urgency adverb).

sections.heading: Extending the frames
paragraphs: The body-part frame: माझं डोके दुखते (head), माझं पाठ दुखते (back), माझं पाय दुखते (leg). The need frame: मला पाणी पाहिजे, मला दवा पाहिजे, मला आंबुलन्स पाहिजे. The call frame: पोलिस कॉल करा, फायर कॉल करा, मदत कॉल करा.

mistakes.why: Marathi imperative ends in -आ (करा), not -ओ (करो). The need frame मला मदत पाहिजे is more standard.
The course uses आंबुलन्स in Unit 10. Hindi एम्बुलेंस differs in the first vowel.

mistakes.wrong: Saying मेरा पेट दर्द कर रहा है (Hindi)
mistakes.right: माझं पोट दुखते -- body part as subject
mistakes.why: Marathi says the body part hurts (पोट दुखते), not that pain is happening in it. The verb दुखते agrees with the body part.

mcq.question: "I need help" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मला मदत पाहिजे -- the standard need frame from Unit 02.

mcq.question: "Call an ambulance" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: आंबुलन्स कॉल करा -- Unit 10 exact spelling.

mcq.question: "Doctor, my head hurts" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: माझं डोके दुखते -- body part as subject, verb agrees (दुखते).

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for ambulance?
faq.answer: आंबुलन्स -- same word, Devanagari spelling used in Unit 10.

faq.question: How do you say "I am in pain" in Marathi?
faq.answer: Use the body-part frame: माझं डोके दुखते (head), माझं पोट दुखते (stomach), माझं पाय दुखते (leg) -- the body part is the subject.
